CascadeEdge.description: One propagation edge: a parent event's shock flowing to a child ticker.
CascadeEdge.title: CascadeEdge

CascadeNode.description:
A cascade tree rooted at an originating event, as a flat edge list.

`event` is the root (depth-0) originating event; `edges` is every propagation
edge in the tree (each carries parent/child ids + depth, so the tree is fully
reconstructable). Edge weights/relationships come only from the public
supply_chain.py graph.

warnings.description: e.g. 'cycle detected at event X', multi-root notes
warnings.title: Warnings

CascadeNode.title: CascadeNode

Compliance.description:
REQUIRED on every response. Mirrors sdk COMPLIANCE + adds v4 metadata.

Hard regulatory constraint: this object is non-optional. A securities reviewer
must be able to read it and conclude the response is research, not advice.

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory jurisdiction the notice is written for
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

notice.default: YUCLAW research output. Not investment advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations.
notice.description: Canonical not-advice notice (== schema.COMPLIANCE_NOTICE). PLACEHOLDER pending review.
notice.title: Notice

Compliance.title: Compliance

Component.description: One C1–C9 component anatomy. Internal `details` are deliberately excluded.

evidence_ids.description: event_ids (in this response's `evidence`) that fed this component; empty for purely technical/macro components (C1–C5, C7, C9).
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

implemented.description: False if this component is a stub (confidence forced 0)
implemented.title: Implemented

Component.title: Component

Confidence.description: Overall confidence + bucketed Evidence Quality Grade.

basis.description: One-line explanation of how the grade was derived
basis.title: Basis

Confidence.title: Confidence

Evidence.description: A single source event backing the signal. raw_excerpt is SourceLock-verified.

accession_number.description: SEC accession (canonical) when source is an EDGAR filing; null otherwise.
accession_number.title: Accession Number

cascade_depth.description: Depth if a cascade child, else null/0
cascade_depth.title: Cascade Depth

raw_excerpt.description: Verbatim, SourceLock-verified excerpt from the source (<=400 chars).
raw_excerpt.title: Raw Excerpt

Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceGrade.description:
Bucketed Evidence Quality Grade (per ChatGPT review).

Communicates *how well-supported* the signal is, independent of direction.
Deriving rule lives in `Confidence.grade_for()` — deterministic, auditable.
EvidenceGrade.title: EvidenceGrade

ResearchResponse.description: The single unified response. Every v4 surface returns exactly this shape.

as_of.description: Point-in-time instant this signal reflects (ISO-8601, tz-aware)
as_of.title: As Of

cascade.description: Day 6: supply-chain cascade tree that propagated into this ticker. Present ONLY when include_cascade=True (like score/memo). None when not requested or no cascade exists.

components.description: C1–C9 component anatomies (all 9 when status='ok'; empty for status='no_data')
components.title: Components

evidence.description: Source events backing the signal (required key; may be empty for technical-only signals)
evidence.title: Evidence

is_backfill.description: True if as_of is historical/backfilled rather than live
is_backfill.title: Is Backfill

ledger_anchor_url.description: Q3: URL to this signal's entry in the git-anchored Verified Research Ledger (v3/proof/). Null if the ledger run has not published this (ticker, date) yet. Excluded from the ledger_hash so publication state does not change the content hash.
ledger_anchor_url.title: Ledger Anchor Url

ledger_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical response (verification anchor)
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

limitations.description: Explicit caveats — what this does NOT consider
limitations.title: Limitations

overlay_trigger.description: Q3: the specific event that triggered an overlay (e.g. the REGULATORY_ACTION/LAWSUIT that forced RISK_ALERT). Also present in `evidence`; denormalized here so the memo can lead with the headline event. None when no overlay applied.

replay_id.description: Opaque handle to reconstruct this exact response point-in-time
replay_id.title: Replay Id

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (set only when status='rate_limited').
retry_after.title: Retry After

score.description: Composite directional score [-1,1] (v3 total_score). Q2: gated — default OFF for REST/MCP (opt in via include_score), default ON for SDK/CLI. None when not included.
score.title: Score

signal_overlay.description: If the label diverges from the score-derived band, why (e.g. 'RISK_ALERT: REGULATORY_ACTION/LAWSUIT within 30d'). None when label == score band.
signal_overlay.title: Signal Overlay

status.description: 'ok' = a signal was found; 'no_data' = no snapshot for (ticker, as_of); 'rate_limited' = quota exceeded. ALL carry the required compliance block.
status.title: Status
